title: Rara Lake Tour

itinerary.text: Fly in, overnight briefing and gear check.

itinerary.text: Boat ride, lakeside villages, Rara National Park.

itinerary.title: Day 5 — Return to Talcha, fly out
itinerary.text: Trek back and departure flight.

itinerary.title: Day 8-11 — Return trek
itinerary.text: Retrace route with alternate side trails.

itinerary.title: Day 12 — Fly back to Kathmandu

itinerary.text: Descend via alternate villages.
